contextPolicy.layer: Current user task and explicit constraints.
Canonical project decisions, active requirements, and current state.
Task-relevant product, design, UX4G, GIGW, research, mock, and implementation records.
Selected supporting references and governed reference websites.
Historical, legacy, benchmark, or superseded material.
Raw source and original archives used only for provenance, disputes, missing detail, or full-system audit.
contextPolicy.rule: Never load the whole corpus for a narrow task.
Derived corrections are promoted into records; raw files are not repeatedly reopened as working context.
